ui_ids.note: WT-UI-003: stable semantic ids now attached as meta('ui_id') on the existing controls. They add no node, no signal and no behaviour, and the verifier finds them by id only - never by visible text and never by child index. Measured: every required id present, no duplicates, one id per vehicle card (7).

navigation.note: WT-UI-003 navigation state, verified through real mouse and key events on visible controls (39 checks, 0 failed).
edges: tab.battle <-> tab.loadout <-> tab.training (visibility toggle only; hidden pages leave the focus chain)
garage.nav.research -> VehicleResearchTree modal (Frontend hidden), Esc -> Frontend shown + refresh, focus restored to garage.nav.research
garage.nav.quit -> AppDialog modal, Esc -> dismissed without quitting, focus restored to garage.nav.quit
garage.deploy -> real deploy request -> match scene

modal_rules_reused.changed: scripts/ui/vehicle_research_tree.gd now attaches the modal BEFORE hiding the frontend, so the source control is recorded and focus can be restored

view_contracts.note: WT-UI-003: 08_VIEW_CONTRACTS.json mapped onto the services that exist today. It is a display-input proposal, not an API guarantee: nothing was renamed and no second model was created. Anything not currently exposed is marked missing and must be shown as unknown/unavailable rather than filled with a sample value.

garage.nation_label: GarageFrontend._country(id) (data-derived; the flat 'USA' display hard-code is a WT-UI-004 item)
garage.role_label: MISSING - no role/service label is exposed today
garage.blocked_reason: MISSING - only coarse readiness codes exist; a readable reason must be added in WT-UI-004, not invented in the UI

battle.inventory_counts: Gunner rounds remaining / supply_status (existing observed key)

respawn.death_reason: MISSING - not exposed as text today
respawn.block_reason: PARTIAL - the waiting panel exists but a per-case reason is not exposed

result.result_receipt_id: MISSING - no receipt id exists today

view_contracts.unknown_value_policy: display unavailable or an em dash plus explanation; never synthesise zero

reuse_rules.font: CoreUI.FONT = res://assets/fonts/NotoSansCJKsc-Regular.otf (scripts/core/core_ui.gd:3). Reuse it; no new font download or bundled font.
reuse_rules.theme: Extend scripts/ui/garage_theme.gd (WT-UI-002); do not add a competing theme system.
reuse_rules.text: All Chinese strings go through LocalizationService; component factories stay in CoreUI/GarageTheme.

forbidden_by_design: UI reads business state and submits intent only: no changes to drive, armor, ammunition, tickets, rewards, admission or AI
no second catalog, inventory or save system; existing controls, signals, services and lifecycles stay
no demo values in production UI; missing state shows explicit unknown or disabled
no show_page() bypass, no emitted fake signals and no direct request_respawn() as normal-operation evidence
hidden, disabled or unreachable controls must not be clicked; no modal input passthrough
no currency, level or battle-rating display while no such system exists
map player counts come from the real mode configuration; 16 berths must not be presented as supported 16v16
